reviews.author: Angela P.
reviews.text: Hail wrecked our ridge caps and Lone Star had a claim filed before our neighbors even got quotes. The crew was polite, tarped everything, and delivered ahead of schedule.

reviews.author: Carlos M.
reviews.text: They repaired a valley leak we'd chased for two years. Thermal imaging found it in ten minutes. Honest people, fair price.

reviews.author: Denise W.
reviews.text: Beautiful metal roof and a spotless site. Walked us through every material option and didn't push the upgrade. Rare integrity.

testimonials.name: Hector Villanueva
testimonials.text: After a wildfire-adjacent cleanup and a full re-roof, Lone Star treated our 1960s home like their own. They matched the neighborhood character and the roof is stunning.

testimonials.name: Maureen & George Burns
testimonials.text: Storm panels arrived on a Sunday and their response crew was on our roof Monday morning. The adjuster fight? They handled the whole thing. We just signed.

testimonials.name: Tara Okafor
testimonials.text: We run 18 rental units across Dallas and Lone Star maintains every one of them. Their inspection program caught two developing leaks before they became disasters.
